name: dot
description: An always-on assistant with a name and a face: give it goals, and it keeps working on them in background rounds, asks before risky actions, briefs you in the morning and pings you when it needs a decision.

workEveryMinutes.title: Work round interval (minutes)
workEveryMinutes.description: How often a background round runs. A round with no queued goal stops right away.

briefingTime.title: Morning briefing (HH:MM, weekdays)
briefingTime.description: Local time of the weekday briefing. Leave empty for none.

openOnStart.title: Open its pane when a session starts
openOnStart.description: Keeps the dot beside the chat; close the pane to hide it for that session.
